message:
Merge pull request #44 from rzkmak/master

Add option to specify amount of workers and max workers spawned

pr.title: Add option to specify amount of workers and max workers spawned
pr.body:
Adds a new flag for issue #27 

-  `-w` or `--workers` to specify the amount of workers spawned
-  `-W` or `--max-workers` to specify the maximum amount of workers spawned

linkedIssues.title: Support workers options
linkedIssues.body:
- [ ] Enable to specify the initial number of workers by giving `-w`or `--workers`
- [ ] Enable to specify the maximum number of workers by giving `-W`or `--max-workers`

Only tiny changes are required because all we have to do is just pass to the Vegeta API.
